mentions.description: A website that keeps U.S. car owners informed about vehicle issues that car makers communicate to dealerships, offering a better experience than the NHTSA's website for finding these communications.
mentions.problem: Information about car issues communicated by car makers to dealerships is hard for owners to access, and the NHTSA's website is not good enough.
mentions.audience: U.S. car owners who want to stay informed about issues their car may experience

mentions.name: Dipstick Alerts
mentions.description: A web app that lets U.S. car owners see a list of all Technical Service Bulletins (TSBs) their car's manufacturer has issued over the years, covering not only recalls but also fixes for known issues, and lets them subscribe to receive new bulletins by email. The infrastructure is built on Cloudflare Workers, and Gemini Flash Lite is used to summarize and filter the bulletins.
mentions.problem: Car owners can miss symptoms of known issues with their cars because service bulletins are hard to discover; the author found fixes (e.g., a tailgate not lifting fully in cold weather) that were covered under extended warranty only by reading through these bulletins.
mentions.audience: Car owners in the U.S. who want to stay informed about service bulletins and known issues for their vehicles.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://dipstickalerts.com - I've been working on this during my kid's naps.

The web app allows car owners in the U.S. to see a list of all the service bulletins the manufacturer has sent out about your car over the years (called Technical Service Bulletins or TSBs). You can subscribe for new bulletins to be sent to your email as well.
